title: Fix stale dates and titles in the campaign and parked rows before the next email: kickoff says November 11, beta says ends Dec 31, five parked rows rest on retired premises

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:

FIX DIRECTION: Patch the rows by fragment: retitle, correct dates, close the five parked rows, correct evidence. Daniel approves the campaign schedule separately.

FIXED 2026-11-16: kickoff retitled to the Nov 17 start, launch-campaign dates corrected to Jan 1 / Jan 31, LIVE-1134 and OWN-101 corrected (YouTube present, LinkedIn and Facebook missing), FH-002 and PROG-E6 and DEF-ETSY evidence noted. The five parked rows (LIVE-106, 229, 255, 797, 911) already carry parked status with their superseded notes; no further edit. FH-002 stays open for its scarcity-race acceptance.
